'''Death from Above''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of five [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper]]s dispatched to the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
